FULL TEXT:
Walk-In-Interview
for project staff under Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) of State Support Mission, Chandigarh at
Panjab University, Chandigarh
Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) of State Support Mission, Chandigarh
for FY 2025-26 is inviting the interested eligible candidates to appear for Walk in Interview for different
temporary posts as mentioned against each Project in different theme area in the attached Annexures. Eligibility
Qualifications, Job Description and corresponding Emoluments are mentioned against each Project Position in
attached Annexures.
S.No Theme Name PI Details of Posts
1 Tourism Prof Prashant Gautam Annexure-I
2 Healthcare Dr Rupinder Kaur Annexure-II
3 Environment Monitoring Prof Prashant Jindal Annexure-III
4 Education, Skill Development, Employment
& Economic Ability
Prof Suveera Gill Annexure-IV
Reporting Date and Time: 22 December, 2025 at 10.00 AM
Reporting Venue: Centre for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, First Floor, CALEM Building
South Campus, Panjab University, Sector 25, Chandigarh
Application Procedure
● All interested candidates may appear for Walk-In-Interview as per the Reporting time at the reporting
Venue mentioned above, along with the duly filled application form available below.
● Incomplete application forms and applications that are not in proper format may be summarily rejected.
● Candidates should ensure that the information mentioned in the application form is accurate. Once the
application form is submitted no further request regarding any changes/ information in the application
form will be considered.
● The duly filled application form must be submitted at the time of reporting by 10:00 AM on 22.12.2025
● The candidates must ascertain their eligibility before applying for different positions, as ineligible
candidates will not be interviewed.
● All the candidates are requested to appear for a walk-in interview with the application form, experience
certificates, publications and original degree certificates and transcripts.
● No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
● Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the candidate(s).
Posts are purely on temporary basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
